First, convert 21 weeks and 1 day to days:  
21 weeks × 7 days/week = 147 days, plus 1 day = 148 days.  

Subtract 148 days from 1404-08-26.  

1404 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
August has 31 days.  

From Aug 26 back 26 days → Aug 0 → July 31.  
148 total days:  
26 days to reach July 31 → 122 days left.  

July has 31 days, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 29 (leap year), January 31.  

Subtract:  
July: 31 days (from July 31 back to July 0) → 122 - 31 = 91 left.  
June: 30 days → 91 - 30 = 61 left.  
May: 31 days → 61 - 31 = 30 left.  
April: 30 days → 30 - 30 = 0 left.  

So landing on April 1? Let’s check carefully:  

From July 31 back 31 days → July 0 = June 30.  
From June 30 back 30 days → June 0 = May 31.  
From May 31 back 31 days → May 0 = April 30.  
From April 30 back 30 days → April 0 = March 31.  

But we had 122 days left after reaching July 31.  
July 31 → July 0 (June 30): 31 days used.  
June 30 → June 0 (May 31): 30 days used (total 61 used).  
May 31 → May 0 (April 30): 31 days used (total 92 used).  
April 30 → April 0 (March 31): 30 days used (total 122 used).  

Exactly 122 days used from July 31 to March 31.  

So 148 total days:  
26 days from Aug 26 to July 31, plus 122 days from July 31 to March 31.  

Thus new date = March 31, 1404.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1404-03-31
